<thought>We have a dominant peak at m/z 224.120115, which matches the exact monoisotopic mass of C₁₆H₁₆O (224.120115 Da). The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 17.5 %, M+2 ≈ 1.6 %) is consistent with 16 carbons and no hetero‑atoms that would give larger isotope peaks. Thus the molecular formula of the sample compound is C₁₆H₁₆O.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H16O</final_answer>
